scientific_source.context: Squid giant axon; empirical voltage-clamp fitted membrane equations, not fin tissue
scientific_source.data_status: Published fitted parameters; no raw measurements digitized, no new empirical validation
scientific_source.voltage_conversion: V_here = -65 mV - V_original; ENa=50, EK=-77, EL=-54.387 mV. The original Table 3 leakage offset is -10.613 mV.

read_sections: rates procedure: modern alpha/beta laws and temperature scaling
implementation_crosscheck.difference: NEURON hh.mod rounds EL to -54.3 mV; this implementation retains Table 3's -54.387 mV. NEURON is not the execution engine.

engine_assessment.status: Official README and current pyproject inspected; package absent locally. Full seed/init/sim electrodiffusion workflow was not installed or run in this bounded task. No BETSE compatibility or run is claimed.
engine_assessment.chosen_engine: Independent NumPy implementation of published HH membrane equations plus assumed ohmic gap network

source_envelope.species: Squid axon source; no Exocoetidae calibration
source_envelope.parameter_transfer: Temperature follows source Q10=3; conductance changes and coupling are design scenarios, not measurements
source_envelope.validation_level: Numerical/model controls only; independent biological validation not attempted

limitations: SIMULATED: published squid-axon membrane kinetics; not measured fin voltages.
Equal-area 12-cell sealed chain and ohmic gap conductance are assumed design scenarios.
All cells start at -65 mV with gates at their voltage-dependent steady states; perturbed conductances need not initially be at equilibrium.
Fixed extracellular potential and reversal potentials represent infinite buffered ion reservoirs; no ion mass balance, pumps or depletion is modeled.
Current is injected into cell 0 during 5 <= t < 6 ms; positive current is inward and depolarizing.
No cross-scale map to gene expression, tissue pattern, fin anatomy, stiffness or flight has been established.

open_questions.question: Which ion channels, reservoir concentrations and gap conductances determine fin-cell voltage and its causal relation to tissue pattern?
open_questions.next_evidence: Species- and developmental-stage-matched voltage/channel/coupling measurements and a held-out perturbation prediction.

open_questions.question: Can a measured tissue voltage perturbation predict fin geometry or material properties through a calibrated causal model?
open_questions.next_evidence: An independently tested voltage-to-pattern-to-geometry bridge with uncertainty; no such calibration is in this model.
